WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(tc.order_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(tc.order_count - ac.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE tc.order_count > ac.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: The average across types includes each distinct order type present among matched orders; NULL order types, if present, form a type group.
